prompt: Objective: decide whether a European bank should enter the US. What you've learned: the US market is large but slow-growing. Latest finding: four incumbents hold 70% of deposits. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check whether the bank has an edge that could win share
options.feedback: Right. Four incumbents hold 70%. Whether the client can win share comes before how to enter.

options.text: Estimate US deposit growth over the next decade
options.feedback: Already answered: the market is slow-growing.

options.text: Work out whether to buy a bank or build branches
options.feedback: That's how to enter, which comes after whether the bank can win.

options.text: Map the approvals a foreign bank needs
options.feedback: Useful later, once entry makes sense.

explanation: The market is concentrated. Test whether the client has an edge before choosing how to enter.
